nodes.name: Ni foam pretreatment
nodes.procedure: The Ni foam was immersed in 1 M HCl and ethanol, and sonicated to remove oxides on the surface.
nodes.source_text: Preparation H-CoSx/NF: The Ni foam was immersed in 1 M HCl and ethanol, and sonicated to remove oxides on the surface.

nodes.name: ZIF-67/NF hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: Solution A was prepared with 1.3 g of 2-methylimidazole and 40 mL of deionized water. Solution B was prepared with 0.60 g of Co(NO3)2·6H2O and 40 mL of deionized water. The soaking solution was prepared by quickly adding solution A to solution B. The ZIF-67/NF preparation started by soaking Ni foam in the prepared solution for 4 h. After washing the treated Ni foam with ethanol, it was dried under vacuum condition at 40°C to form ZIF-67/NF.

nodes.name: H-CoSx@NiFe LDH/NF electrodeposition (60s)
nodes.procedure: The H-CoSx@NiFe LDH/NF samples were prepared using the electrodeposition method. The process involved a 3-electrode system, in which H-CoSx/NF (1 cm × 1 cm), saturated calomel electrode (SCE), and Pt coil were used as the working, reference, and counter electrodes, respectively. A solution containing 0.15 M nickel nitrate and 0.15 M iron sulfate was used as the electrolyte. Electrodeposition was performed at a constant voltage of -1.0 V (vs SCE) for 60 s, and this sample was denoted as H-CoSx@NiFe LDH/NF.

nodes.name: RuO2/NF preparation
nodes.procedure: Catalyst ink was prepared by dispersing 5 mg of RuO2 catalyst powder in a solution of 475 μL of 2-propanol, 475 μL of deionized water, and 50 μL of Nafion, followed by sonication for 30 min. The RuO2/NF sample was prepared by the drop-wise addition of 50 μL of the prepared catalyst ink onto NF (1 cm × 1 cm, 0.25 mg cm⁻²).

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM reveals hollow structure of CoS_x nanoarrays indicated by red dashed line and aligned coverage on NF without aggregation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As expected, the obtained amorphous CoS_x nanoarray possessed a hollow structure, as confirmed by scanning electron microscopy (SEM, Figure 1c,d, indicated by the red dashed line).

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM reveals hollow structure of CoS_x nanoarrays and lamellar structure of NiFe LDH with length of 45 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The transmission electron microscopy (TEM) images further revealed the hollow structure of the CoS_x nanoarrays (Figure 2c,d) and the lamellar structure of NiFe LDH with a length of 45 nm.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows NiFe LDH nanosheets consist of few layers with crystal lattices separated by 0.24 nm due to (012) plane; no lattice fringes for amorphous CoS_x.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In Figure 2f, the HRTEM image revealed that the crystal lattices were separated by 0.24 nm due to the (012) plane of NiFe LDH. In contrast, no lattice fringes corresponding to the CoS_x crystal structure were observed owing to the amorphous nature of CoS_x.

nodes.characterization_summary: SAED shows no distinct crystal structure of CoS_x.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Similarly, no distinct crystal structure of CoS_x was detected by ... selected area electron diffraction (SAED) patterns (Figure 2g).

nodes.characterization_summary: EDX mapping confirms overlapping of Co, Ni, Fe, S, and O elements; atomic ratio of S:Co:Ni:Fe ≈ 1.0:0.4:0.26:0.09.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In energy dispersive X-ray (EDX) mapping images, the overlapping of the Co, Ni, Fe, S, and O elements further confirmed the successful integration of CoS_x and NiFe LDH nanosheets (Figure 2h). The EDX spectrum and quantification results showed that the atomic ratio of S, Co, Ni, and Fe elements were approximately 1.0:0.4:0.26:0.09.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD shows no distinct crystal structure of CoS_x; absence of NiFe LDH diffraction pattern attributed to ultrathin thickness.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Similarly, no distinct crystal structure of CoS_x was detected by XRD (Figure S3, Supporting Information) or selected area electron diffraction (SAED) patterns (Figure 2g). The absence of a diffraction pattern corresponding to NiFe LDH in the XRD analysis may be attributed to the ultrathin thickness and small size of the NiFe LDH nanosheets.

nodes.characterization_summary: HR XPS shows Co 2p peaks for Co³⁺ (780.9, 796.8 eV), Co²⁺ (783.0, 798.7 eV) with satellites; Ni 2p at 855.9 (2p₃/₂), 873.7 eV (2p₁/₂); Fe 2p at 712.6 (2p₃/₂), 725.2 eV (2p₁/₂); S 2p at 162.4 (2p₃/₂), 163.3 (2p₁/₂), 168.6 eV (S-O). Binding energies shift due to strong electronic coupling between CoS_x and NiFe LDH.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The HR Co 2p spectrum of H-CoS_x@NiFe LDH/NF (Figure 3a) may be divided into multiple peaks corresponding to Co³⁺ (780.9 and 796.8 eV), Co²⁺ (783.0 and 798.7 eV) and satellite peaks (786.9 and 802.5 eV, annotated as Sat.). As for the Ni 2p spectrum... two major peaks located at 855.9 and 873.7 eV... In the HR Fe 2p spectrum... Fe 2p₃/₂ (712.6 eV), Fe 2p₁/₂ (725.2 eV)... Figure 3d showed the HR spectra of S 2p... S 2p₃/₂, S 2p₁/₂, and oxidized S (S-O) were observed at 162.4, 163.3, and 168.6 eV... the binding energies of Co 2p, Ni 2p, and Fe 2p for H-CoS@ NiFe LDH/NF exhibited a significant shift.

nodes.characterization_summary: CV estimates C_dl of 80.0 mF cm^-2 for H-CoS_x@NiFe LDH/NF, significantly larger than NiFe LDH/NF (2.5 mF cm^-2) and H-CoS_x/NF (27.2 mF cm^-2).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The H-CoS_x @ NiFe LDH/NF electrode exhibited a significantly larger C_dl (80.0 mF cm^-2) than the NiFe LDH/NF (2.5 mF cm^-2) and H-CoS_x /NF (27.2 mF cm^-2) electrodes.

nodes.characterization_summary: Contact angle measurement shows H-CoS_x@NiFe LDH/NF has 0° (superhydrophilic) while H-CoS_x/NF has 117°.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The H-CoS_x @ NiFe LDH/NF showed a liquid CA of 0° (Figure S9, Supporting Information), while the H-CoS_x /NF displayed a large static liquid CA of 117°.
